７ Note
While the contain user action is used both in attack disruption and predictive
shielding, this action is applied differently in each context. In predictive shielding, the
contain user action applies restrictions more selectively, with a focus on users
identified as high risk through prediction logic. This action prevents new sessions
rather than terminating existing ones.
